name: ElevenLabs：每月 10,000 免费音频 credits
description: 免费计划每月提供 10,000 credits，可探索语音合成、转写和音效；不同模型消耗不同。
content: 免费生成内容仅限非商业用途，并需署名。API 与网页端存在功能差异，免费用户不能通过 API 使用 Voice Library。商业许可从付费计划开始；不要把 credits 直接当作固定分钟数。

en.name: ElevenLabs: 10,000 monthly audio credits
en.description: Free includes 10,000 monthly credits for exploring speech, transcription and sound effects; consumption varies by model.
en.content: Free output is non-commercial and requires attribution. Free users cannot access Voice Library through the API. A paid plan is needed for commercial licensing. Credits are not a fixed duration.

name: Deepgram：一次性 $200 API 试用额度
description: 注册可获 $200 免费额度，官方称不设到期时间且无需信用卡；额度用完后按量付费。
content: 这是注册试用，不是每月赠送 $200。转写、语音合成和语音 Agent 使用不同计费单位，能处理多少音频取决于模型和功能。公开定价复核不等于账户实测，商业输出和水印条款需单独确认。

en.name: Deepgram: $200 introductory API credit
en.description: Sign up for $200 in free credit, with no credit card and no expiration stated on the current pricing page.
en.content: This is a signup allowance, not a monthly grant. Speech recognition, speech synthesis and voice agents use different billing units. Effective duration varies by product. Commercial-output and watermark terms need separate review.

name: AssemblyAI：$50 一次性转写试用
description: 官方支持文档确认 $50 免费 API 试用，覆盖预录音频和流式转写，开始时无需信用卡。
content: 该试用额度不按月恢复。定价页还提供最高 185 小时预录转写和 333 小时流式转写示例，实际时长受模型与功能影响，不应相加为独立余额。免费层不支持 LLM Gateway，额度耗尽后需升级。

en.name: AssemblyAI: $50 transcription trial
en.description: Official support documents a $50 API trial for prerecorded and streaming transcription; pricing says no card is required to start.
en.content: The trial does not renew monthly. Pricing advertises model-dependent hour examples, which must not be treated as separate additive pools. LLM Gateway is excluded. Upgrade is required when the free allowance is exhausted.

name: Speechmatics：$100 注册额度与 TTS 体验
description: 官方定价提供无需绑卡的 $100 注册额度，注册奖励有效期 12 个月；TTS 另列首 100 万字符免费。
content: 注册奖励不是每月额度。语音合成首 100 万字符活动也不应描述为周期性赠送。免费层 credits 用尽后 API 暂停；额度折算的时长随模型变化。商业许可和水印要求请查对应产品条款。

en.name: Speechmatics: $100 signup credit
en.description: Current pricing offers $100 signup credit without a card, valid for 12 months, plus a separately advertised first million TTS characters free.
en.content: Signup credit is not monthly. Do not describe the TTS introductory allowance as recurring. Free API access pauses when credits run out. Effective duration varies by model; commercial and watermark terms require separate review.

name: Cartesia：每月 20,000 语音 credits
description: Free 计划每月提供 20,000 credits，TTS 与 STT 共享；另有 $1/月的语音 Agent 预付余额。
content: 模型 credits 与 Agent 美元余额是不同资源，不能相加。Agent 分钟估算不包含电话费用。商业使用许可从 Pro 开始，免费计划应优先用于个人学习与原型。当前公开定价未明确本次研究需要的绑卡条件。

en.name: Cartesia: 20,000 monthly voice credits
en.description: Free provides a shared monthly pool of 20,000 TTS/STT credits and a separate $1 monthly prepaid voice-agent balance.
en.content: Model credits and agent dollars are separate. Agent-minute estimates exclude telephony. Commercial licensing starts at Pro, so Free suits personal exploration and prototypes. Card requirements were not established by the reviewed pricing page.

name: Fish Audio：S2.1 Pro 免费 API 限时开放
description: 官方 `s2.1-pro-free` API 活动当前延长至 2026 年 11 月 30 日，无需信用卡，受公平使用政策约束。
content: 这是有截止日期的活动，不是永久不限量承诺。官方表示无硬性字符上限，但可能限流；不提供 SLA 或延迟保证，请求可能用于改善模型。部分商业场景受限，年经常性收入超过 $100 万的产品应先联系厂商。网页端另有每月 8,000 credits 的个人非商业免费计划，不应混同。

en.name: Fish Audio: temporary free S2.1 Pro API
en.description: The s2.1-pro-free promotion currently runs through November 30, 2026, without a card and subject to Fair Use.
en.content: This is a dated promotion, not permanent unlimited access. There is no hard character cap, but throttling is possible; no SLA or latency guarantee applies and requests may improve models. Some commercial scenarios are restricted; products above $1M ARR should contact Fish Audio. Consumer credits are separate.

name: Suno：每日 50 音乐生成 credits
description: 免费计划每日补充 50 生成 credits，可在站内尝试歌曲创作；新账号免费导出不作保证。
content: 免费作品仅限个人非商业用途。2026 年 9 月 3 日起注册的新免费用户，仅可能偶尔获得试用下载；不要把每日生成 credits 写成每日免费歌曲下载。之后订阅也不会默认追溯授予免费作品商业权利。未验证官方免费 API。

en.name: Suno: 50 daily music-generation credits
en.description: Free replenishes 50 generation credits daily for in-app song creation. Free downloads are not guaranteed for new accounts.
en.content: Free songs are personal and non-commercial. Accounts joining on or after September 3, 2026 may only occasionally receive trial downloads. Generation credits are not download credits. A later subscription does not automatically license earlier Free songs commercially. No official free API was verified.

name: Leonardo.Ai：每日 150 fast tokens
description: 免费消费者计划每日提供 150 fast tokens，支持图片及部分创意工具体验；当前免费模型选择受限。
content: 免费作品公开，当前定价列出 Auto Only 模型访问。官方说明免费作品由 Leonardo 持有，但授予用户商业使用许可；公开作品不等于独占或私密。API 单独计费，不应把网页每日 tokens 视作 API 额度，也不要承诺所有视频或音频模型均免费。

en.name: Leonardo.Ai: 150 daily fast tokens
en.description: The consumer Free plan provides 150 fast tokens daily for image creation and selected creative tools, with restricted model access.
en.content: Free creations are public and pricing lists Auto Only model access. Official guidance says Leonardo owns free outputs while granting a commercial-use license. Public outputs are not private or exclusive. API pricing is separate; not every advertised multimedia model is guaranteed on Free.

name: Krea：每日 100 免费 compute units
description: 免费网页计划每日恢复 100 compute units，无需信用卡；不同模型和操作消耗不同。
content: 没有固定免费出图或视频条数，实际可用模型与功能受免费层限制。官方定价 FAQ 仅为付费计划列出商业许可，因此不要将 Free 描述为可商用。消费者订阅与 API 余额分开计费，每日网页额度不能直接用于 API。

en.name: Krea: 100 daily compute units
en.description: The free consumer plan refills 100 compute units daily, without a credit card. Different models and operations consume different amounts.
en.content: There is no fixed guaranteed image or video count. Free access is limited by model and feature. The pricing FAQ lists commercial licenses for paid plans, so do not promise commercial rights on Free. API balances are billed separately from consumer subscriptions.

name: Clipdrop：免费图片编辑工具额度
description: 背景移除、x2 放大、Cleanup 与 Relight 各列出 20 次/24 小时；文字移除列出 50 次/24 小时。
content: 这是网页工具额度，API 另按量计费。免费 Cleanup 导出上限为 720px。定价页面未给出可靠的免费文生图数值，不应编造。绑卡条件、商业使用和水印权利未由本次查阅页面明确，需要用户按具体工具确认。

en.name: Clipdrop: free daily image-editing allowances
en.description: Background removal, x2 upscaling, Cleanup and Relight each list 20 operations per 24 hours; text removal lists 50.
en.content: These are web allowances; API usage is billed separately. Free Cleanup exports are limited to 720px. No reliable numeric free text-to-image quota appeared. Card requirements, commercial rights and watermark terms were not established by the reviewed pages.
